ns1:item.ns1:title: Using satellite-based products to determine surface soil moisture dynamics
ns1:item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00842-7

Dariana Isamel Avila-Velasquez explains how satellite-derived datasets can help understand surface soil moisture dynamics at regional to global scales.
ns1:item.dc:title: Using satellite-based products to determine surface soil moisture dynamics

ns1:item.ns1:title: Environmental legal frameworks must consider Earth system dynamics
ns1:item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00836-5

Comprehensive environmental codes, exemplified by China’s new Ecological and Environmental Code, seek to integrate governance across climate, biodiversity and pollution, yet remain misaligned with the dynamic, interconnected nature of Earth system processes. Aligning legal frameworks with these dynamics requires adaptive, process-based governance, predictive monitoring and modelling, and cross-scale coordination.
ns1:item.dc:title: Environmental legal frameworks must consider Earth system dynamics
ns1:item.dc:creator: Hong Yang
Xiang Gao
Jianhua Wu
Julian R. Thompson
ns1:item.dc:source: Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 2026-09-30; | doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00836-5
